inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Sheltering Drills for Lock-Down-4 times in a calendar year: There were no current sheltering drills available during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sheltering Drills for Lock-Down-4 times in a calendar year (26 TAC §746.5205(3))

occurrences.finding: Sheltering Drill For Severe Weather-Four times a calendar year: There were no current severe weather drills available during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sheltering Drill For Severe Weather-Four times a calendar year (26 TAC §746.5205(2))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: One out of five files was missing twelve hours of annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded: Two out of nine rooms had fans that was not mounted in the classroom.    This was corrected at inspection when the director removed the fans from the two classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded (26 TAC §746.3701(3))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The operation did not have a current  CPSC form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Access to All Records: The persons in charge did not have access to all essential information. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Access to All Records (26 TAC §746.1013(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Current Driver's License: A copy of the van driver's current drivers license was not on file. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Current Driver's License (26 TAC §746.901(10))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Of the 10 personnel records evaluated, two did not receive training in one or more of the following topics: responding to and preventing reactions to food allergies, administering medication and handling, storing and disposing of hazardous materials.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: The fire extinguisher on the bus has not been serviced within the last year. The date of the last service was October 2022. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training: The bus driver is not current with the required transportation safety course. The training was last completed in October 2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(7)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Of the 10 children's records evaluated, 3 lacked the address of the emergency contact.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child: Of the 10 children's records evaluated, 2 lacked the phone number of the school the child attends.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child (26 TAC §746.605(14))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission: Of the 10 children;s records evaluated,3 lacked a  health care statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission (26 TAC §746.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation - You must inactivate a subject who is no longer associated with your operation within 7 days of leaving: Background checks for staff who are not longer employed by the center have not been inactivated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation - You must inactivate a subject who is no longer associated with your operation within 7 days of leaving (26 TAC §745.651(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: Of the 10 children's records evaluated, 2 were behind with immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The operational policies does not include the following information:  1. Procedures for parental notifications  2. Emergency preparedness plan  3. Staff training requirements for abuse and neglect, steps the center will take to increase parent and staff awareness, steps the center will take to increase parent and staff awareness for prevention techniques, community organizations, and actions a parent of a child who is a victim of abuse should take to obtain assistance  4. The requirements for physical activity and outdoor play  5. Staff vaccination requirements
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements: Of the 10 personnel records evaluated, 1 lacked documentation of their GED.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §746.901(2))

occurrences.finding: Education Outside of U.S.: Of the 10 personnel decors evaluated, 1 lacked documentation that the education received outside of the United States is the equivalent to a United States high school diploma.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Education Outside of U.S. (26 TAC §746.1111)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Of the 10 children's records evaluated, 2 lacked a shot record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: Infants were sitting in seatswhere either the safety straps were not fastened or the seat was not equipped with the required straps.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area: All of the required steps are not being done when using a bleach/water solution as the disinfectant. When a bleach/water solution is used as the disinfectant, the 4-step sanitizing process must be followed:  1. Spray with soap and water  2. Rinse with clear water  3. Spray or soak in a disinfectant solution for at least two minutes. Rinse with cool water items children are likely to place in their mouths.  4. Allow the item to air dry  This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3505(e))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: The required authorization for emergency medical transport and treatment authorization forms for each child being transported are not on the center's bus.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone: A caregiver was allowed access to children in care without a backgriound check being submitted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone (26 TAC §745.621(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics: The director did not receive annual training hours in the following topics for the previous training years:  1. Administering medications  2. Food allergies  3. Handling, storing and disposing of hazardous materials
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Of the 10 personnel record evaluated, five did not receive annual training hours in the following topics for there respective training years:  1. Administering medications  2. Food allergies  3. Handling, storing and disposing of hazardous materials
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation Training: The bus driver is not current with the required two clock hour transportation safety training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation Training (26 TAC §746.1301(7)(A))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Of the 10 children's records evaluated, four were behind with immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation: Of the 10 personnel records evaluated, four did not have documentation that the following topics were covered in orientation:  1. Administering medications  2. Food allergies  3. Handling, storing and disposing of hazardous materials
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(1)(A))
